arxiv-2109-07870.title: Schwarz lemma: the case of equality and an extension
arxiv-2109-07870.creator: Haojie Chen, Xiaolan Nie
arxiv-2109-07870.description: Abstract . We prove two results related to the Schwarz lemma in complex geometry. First, we show that if the inequality in the Schwarz lemmata of Yau, Royden and Tosatti becomes equality at one point, then the equality holds on the whole manifold. In particular, the holomorphic map is totally geodesic and has constant rank.

arxiv-2110-15398.title: A Fermi-Hubbard Optical Tweezer Array
arxiv-2110-15398.creator: Benjamin M. Spar, Elmer Guardado-Sanchez, Sungjae Chi, Zoe Z. Yan, Waseem S. Bakr
arxiv-2110-15398.description: Abstract We use lithium-6 atoms in an optical tweezer array to realize an eight-site Fermi-Hubbard chain near half filling. We achieve single site detection by combining the tweezer array with a quantum gas microscope. By reducing disorder in the energy offsets to less than the tunneling energy, we observe Mott insulators with strong antiferromagnetic correlations.

arxiv-2209-06881.title: Relation between pole and running masses of heavy quarks using the principle of maximum conformality
arxiv-2209-06881.creator: Daniel Salinas-Arizmendi, Iván Schmidt
arxiv-2209-06881.description: Abstract The relation of the pole and running heavy quark masses of order 𝒪 ⁡ ( α s 4 ) \mathcal{O}\left(\alpha_{s}^{4}\right) in perturbative quantum chromodynamics (pQCD) can be obtained using the Principle of Maximum Conformality (PMC), a formalism that provides a rigorous method for eliminating renormalization scale and scheme ambiguities for observables in pQCD.

arxiv-2211-13404.title: Asymptotic stability and sharp decay rates to the linearly stratified Boussinesq equations in horizontally periodic strip domain
arxiv-2211-13404.creator: Juhi Jang, Junha Kim
arxiv-2211-13404.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Juhi Jang, Junha Kim. We consider an initial boundary value problem of the multi-dimensional Boussinesq equations in the absence of thermal diffusion with velocity damping or velocity diffusion under the stress free boundary condition in horizontally periodic strip domain.

arxiv-2307-09201.title: Blow-up behavior for ODEs with normally hyperbolic nature in dynamics at infinity
arxiv-2307-09201.creator: Kaname Matsue
arxiv-2307-09201.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kaname Matsue. We describe blow-up behavior for ODEs by means of dynamics at infinity with complex asymptotic behavior in autonomous systems, as well as in nonautonomous systems. Based on preceding studies, a variant of closed embeddings of phase spaces and the time-scale transformation determined by the structure of vector fields at infinity reduce our description of blow-ups to unravel the shadowing property of (pre)compact trajectories on the horizon, the geometric object expressing the infinity, with the specific convergence rates.

arxiv-2310-07809.title: On the Robustness of Mechanism Design under Total Variation Distance
arxiv-2310-07809.creator: Anuran Makur, Marios Mertzanidis, Alexandros Psomas, Athina Terzoglou
arxiv-2310-07809.description: Abstract We study the problem of designing mechanisms when agents’ valuation functions are drawn from unknown and correlated prior distributions. In particular, we are given a prior distribution 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , and we are interested in designing a (truthful) mechanism that has good performance for all “true distributions” that are close to 𝒟 \mathcal{D} in Total Variation (TV) distance.

arxiv-2406-09351.title: On the Expressibility of the Reconstructional Color Refinement
arxiv-2406-09351.creator: V. Arvind, Johannes Köbler, Oleg Verbitsky †
arxiv-2406-09351.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by V. Arvind, Johannes Köbler, Oleg Verbitsky †. One of the most basic facts related to the famous Ulam reconstruction conjecture is that the connectedness of a graph can be determined by the deck of its vertex-deleted subgraphs, which are considered up to isomorphism. We strengthen this result by proving that connectedness can still be determined when the subgraphs in the deck are given up to equivalence under the color refinement isomorphism test.

arxiv-2509-14144.title: Algorithms for Optimizing Acyclic Queries
arxiv-2509-14144.creator: Zheng Luo, Wim Van den Broeck, Guy Van den Broeck, Yisu Remy Wang
arxiv-2509-14144.description: Abstract Most research on query optimization has centered on binary join algorithms like hash join and sort-merge join. However, recent years have seen growing interest in theoretically optimal algorithms, notably Yannakakis’ algorithm. These algorithms rely on join trees , which differ from the operator trees for binary joins and require new optimization techniques.

arxiv-2512-07922.title: Beyond Extremality: Weak Gravity Conjecture Constraints on Gravitational Lensing in Gravity’s Rainbow
arxiv-2512-07922.creator: Saeed Noori Gashti, Behnam Pourhassan, İzzet Sakallı
arxiv-2512-07922.description: Abstract We investigate the constraints imposed by the Weak Gravity Conjecture (WGC) on gravitational lensing in gravity’s rainbow, focusing in particular on scenarios beyond extremality and on the interplay between the WGC and the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture (WCCC) in the context of Reissner–Nordström–Anti-de Sitter black holes modified by rainbow gravity.

arxiv-2602-15158.title: da Costa and Tarski meet Goguen and Carnap: a novel approach for ontological heterogeneity based on consequence systems

arxiv-2602-23339.creator: Tilemachos Aravanis, Vladan Stojnić, Bill Psomas, Nikos Komodakis, Giorgos Tolias, VRG, FEE, Czech Technical University in Prague
arxiv-2602-23339.description: Abstract Open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) extends the zero-shot recognition capabilities of vision–language models (VLMs) to pixel-level prediction, enabling segmentation of arbitrary categories specified by text prompts. Despite recent progress, OVS lags behind fully supervised approaches due to two challenges: the coarse image-level supervision used to train VLMs and the semantic ambiguity of natural language.

pmc-13534568.title: 中老年人疼痛和抑郁症状的关系：一项交叉滞后的纵向分析
pmc-13534568.creator: 红红 夏, 旺姆, 红霞 张, 铭 付, 洋 万, 培媛 邱
pmc-13534568.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的探究我国中老年人疼痛与抑郁症状之间的纵向关联，为中老年人疼痛与抑郁的管理提供科学依据。方法利用中国健康与养老追踪调查（China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study, CHARLS）2011-2020年共5次随访数据，纳入年龄≥45岁且完整参与5次调查的中老年人7 876例。采用随机截距交叉滞后面板模型（random intercept cross-lagged panel model, RI-CLPM）分析疼痛与抑郁症状在5个时间点的纵向关系。模型分步控制了以下混杂因素：非时变因素包括性别、户口和婚姻状况；时变因素包括年龄、共病、日常生活活动能力评分、吸烟、饮酒及体力活动情况。结果RI-CLPM模型拟合良好（CFI=0.906，TLI=0.879，RMSEA=0.036，SRMR=0.060）。在控制个体间差异后，RI-CLPM结果显示疼痛对抑郁症状的滞后效应在T1→T5各时间段均具有统计学意义〔T1→T2：β=0.043（95% CI：0.020～0.067）；T2→T3：β=0.047（95% CI：0.023～0.070）；T3→T4：β=0.056（95% CI：0.034～0.078）；T4→T5：β=0.050（95% CI：0.028～0.071）〕；抑郁症状对疼痛的滞后效应在T2→T5阶段有统计学意义，且抑郁症状对疼痛的预测作用更大〔T2→T3：β=0.121（95% CI：0.099～0.143）；T3→T4：β=0.112（95% CI：0.091～0.134）；T4→T5：β=0.070（95% CI：0.049～0.090）〕。结论疼痛与抑郁症状在时间上存在双向预测关系，疼痛对抑郁症状的预测效应稳定存在，而抑郁症状对疼痛的预测效应更强，提示在疼痛患者的诊疗过程中应注重抑郁症状的筛查。 当前，我国老龄化进程日益加快，第七次人口普查数据显示我国已达中度老龄化水平[1]。在此背景下，与老龄化息息相关的心理健康问题也日益凸显。世界卫生组织数据显示，全球约有3.32亿人罹患抑郁[2]，我国中老年人抑郁症患病率约为20.0%[3]。同时抑郁也是导致自杀、自残等不良健康结局的重要风险因素，给照护者和社会带来沉重的疾病负担[2, 4]。 疼痛亦是中老年人群常见的就诊问题之一[5-6]。疼痛不仅会显著降低人们的身体功能和生活质量，同时也与抑郁、焦虑等心理障碍的发生密切相关[7]。既往多项研究表明，疼痛与抑郁症状间存在关联[8-11]，二者的合并发生率高达30%～50%[10, 12]，提示二者间可能存在复杂的相互作用。目前，尽管国内外已开展关于疼痛与抑郁症状间关系的研究，但多局限于横断面水平，且缺乏长期随访的纵向研究证据。 交叉滞后面板模型（cross-lagged panel model, CLPM）是一种基于纵向数据、旨在检验变量间潜在因果关系与时序先后的重要方法，但该模型在估计变量间的动态关联时，未能有效区分不随时间变化的个体稳定特质（如遗传或个性特质）与变量随时间的短期波动，可能导致将个体间存在的固有差异混淆为变量在个体内层面的因果效应，从而造成因果推断上的偏差[13]。相比之下，随机截距交叉滞后面板模型（random intercept cross-lagged panel model, RI-CLPM）通过引入随机截距项，有效控制了由个体稳定特质构成的潜在异质性，从而实现对个体间差异与个体内波动的有效分离，更有利于揭示变量在个体内层面的真实动态关系[14-15]。 因此，本研究拟采用中国健康与养老追踪调查（China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study, CHARLS）的五波纵向数据，构建疼痛和抑郁症状的RI-CLPM，从个体层面探究疼痛与心理健康的相互作用，阐明疼痛和抑郁症状间的长期动态机制，为中老年人疼痛与抑郁的管理提供科学依据。 对象与方法 数据来源 本研究数据来自CHARLS。该项目于2011年启动，旨在评估我国年龄≥45岁中老年人群及其家庭成员的社会、经济与健康状况。采用多阶段概率比例规模抽样方法，以面对面访问形式进行调查，调查范围覆盖中国28个省150个县的450个村级单位[16]。项目于2013年、2015年、2018年、2020年进行了4次随访。本研究选取2011年（T1）、2013年（T2）、2015年（T3）、2018年（T4）、2020年（T5）共计5次调查数据展开分析。本研究经北京大学伦理委员会审查批准（伦理审批编号：IRB00001052-11015），所有研究对象在调查前均签署知情同意书。 本研究对象筛选流程见图1。本研究纳入年龄≥45岁的研究对象。排除标准包括：①研究对象未完整参与5次调查；②基线及随访过程中主要变量及协变量缺失者。最终纳入7 876例研究对象。 Participant screening flow chart 研究对象筛选流程 变量及定义 疼痛 本研究通过计算疼痛部位的数量来反映疼痛情况。疼痛信息基于研究对象的自我报告，通过以下2个问题进行评估：①您的身体是否疼痛？②您感觉身体的哪个部位疼痛（头、肩膀、胳膊、手腕、手指、胸、胃、背、腰、臀、腿、膝盖、脚踝、脚趾、脖子）？根据患者自报疼痛状况进行计分，每出现一个疼痛部位记1分，得分范围为0～15分。 抑郁症状 本研究采用流行病学研究中心抑郁量表（Center for Epidemiological Survey Depression Scale, CESD-10）对受试者的抑郁症状进行评估。该量表共包含10个条目，用于调查研究对象在过去1周内自我报告的抑郁症状发生频率。每个条目包括4个选项：“很少或没有（<1 d）”“偶尔（1～2 d）”“经常（3～4 d）”和“大多时间（5～7 d）”，分别对应0～3分。条目中“我对未来充满了希望”和“我感到很愉快”两个条目为反向计分条目。CESD-10总分范围为0～30分，得分越高反映抑郁症状越严重[17]。CESD-10量表已广泛应用于我国中老年人群中[18]，具有广泛的适用性和良好的信度（Cronbach α=0.815）[19]。 协变量 为减少疼痛和抑郁症状间关联的估计偏差，参考既往研究，本研究将以下因素纳入模型进行调整[17,20-21]。①社会人口学因素：年龄、性别、婚姻状况、户口；②生活方式及行为因素：吸烟、饮酒、体力活动；③健康状况：包括共病、日常生活活动能力（basic activities of daily living, BADL）评分。BADL通过评估个体在进食、穿衣、洗澡、起床、如厕及控制大小便6项日常活动中的自理情况进行评分。每项活动的自理情况分为4个等级：“无困难”“有困难但可独立完成”“有困难需协助才能完成”和“无法完成”。任何一个方面回答“无困难”者赋0分，否则赋1分，BADL得分范围为0～6分。6个方面均为0分者视为BADL正常，否则视为日常功能障碍[22]。将同时患有≥2种慢性病者定义为共病。 pmc-13589292.title: Adolescents’ Experiences of Online Harms by Platform
pmc-13589292.creator: Angela Y. Lee, Carmen H. J. Lim, Sunny Xun Liu, R. Kang Xing Jin, Anneke Buffone, Ravi Iyer, Zachary Rausch, Jonathan Haidt, Nathanael J. Fast, Jeffrey T. Hancock, Eleni Linos
pmc-13589292.description: Key PointsQuestionHow often do US adolescents report having negative experiences online, and does prevalence vary across different online platforms?FindingsThis cross-sectional pilot survey of 472 US adolescents aged 13 to 17 years found that reported negative online experiences varied substantially across platforms.MeaningThese findings provide baseline, platform-level prevalence estimates that may inform future measurement and monitoring of adolescents’ online experiences.
